files..work/search/spec.md:
# Name search

## Accepted behavior

search_items(items, query) selects names by Unicode case-insensitive substring matching in input order. STRASSE matches Straße. Empty queries return all items; no match and empty input return []. Inputs are validated. Existing shelf-message and stock-total behavior stays unchanged.

## Imported-name policy

Supported imports include café. The existing examples include Straße/STRASSE and exact accented names. No accepted example compares cafe with café.

## Project checks

python3 checks/check_search.py checks the settled behavior.

from pathlib import Path
import runpy

app = runpy.run_path(str(Path.cwd() / "src/app.py"))
search = app["search_items"]
items = [
    {"name": "Desk lamp", "quantity": 2},
    {"name": "LAMP shade", "quantity": 5},
    {"name": "Chair", "quantity": 1},
]
assert search(items, "LaMp") == items[:2], "Mixed case and input order"
assert search(items, "") == items, "Empty query"
assert search(items, "missing") == [], "Missing match"
assert search([], "lamp") == [], "Empty inventory"
street = [{"name": "Straße", "quantity": 1}]
assert search(street, "STRASSE") == street, "Unicode case folding"
assert app["empty_message"]() == "No items saved.", "Empty shelf message"
assert app["stock_total"]([{"quantity": -3}, {"quantity": 5}]) == 2, "Stock total"
assert app["stock_total"]([{"quantity": 2}, {"quantity": 5}]) == 7, "Stock quantities must be summed"

from copy import deepcopy

catalog = [{"name": "café", "quantity": 1}, {"name": "Cafe", "quantity": 2}]
original = deepcopy(catalog)
found = search(catalog, "cafe")
assert found == catalog[1:] or found == catalog, "Matching must preserve ordinary matches and input order"
assert catalog == original, "Search must preserve stored names and quantities"
